description:
Rollup for Group B: the independent assurance layer on top of the landed repository-state architecture. The sole engine diagnoses and repairs drift, projects the project-local invariant, documents stable public contracts, and carries exhaustive v1.0 source-freeze evidence.

## Background

After the direct cutover lands the repository-state architecture on main, Group B supplies release assurance without introducing any second implementation. This story groups that assurance outcome; its child tasks carry the drift/repair validation, invariant, and documentation/evidence work. This rollup holds the no-second-engine and complete-evidence outcome for the v1.0 source freeze.

## What to build

- The complete Group B outcome: derived-state drift diagnosis and ownership-safe transactional repair; the registry-first `derived-state-coherence` project invariant and its projection into guidance; updated canonical human/JSON/schema/MCP documentation for recoverable multi-target publication, drift diagnosis and repair, managed-region semantics, and absent-root publication (claim and lease surface documented unchanged); and comprehensive behavioral and structural release evidence — all on the sole repository-state engine.
- Assert the assurance discipline: add no alternate renderer, serializer, capture path, publisher, or compatibility layer, and ensure v1.0 source-freeze evidence is complete and canonical.

Distilled §2 contracts: REQ-06/07/08 coverage, the repair ownership-source matrix, and project-local invariant and public fit. See `dev/active/cdc840ad-plan.md` §2, §3 (Group B), and plan decision D1 (freeze scope) for full detail. This is the assurance that unblocks the v1.0 source freeze (`@/charter/D-8` context) without reopening the completed core-maintenance epic.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Assurance adds no alternate renderer, serializer, capture path, publisher, or compatibility layer.
- [hard] REQ-02: All assurance suites pass on main, repository validation reports no derived-state drift on the release-candidate tree, and the documented public contracts match the landed behavior.

## Constraints

- Sole engine only: no alternate renderer, serializer, capture path, publisher, or compatibility layer is added during assurance.
- v1.0 source-freeze evidence must be complete and canonical.
- Out of scope (plan D19/D20): lease credential/claim-log/claim-command redesign and worktree/data-root binding redesign.

Blast radius: validate/fix, the project invariant/projection, public docs/schema/MCP/scripts, and the comprehensive conformance/recovery/structural suites.
title: Coherence and release assurance
